users_has_identifier.name: users_has_identifier
users_has_identifier.value: phone IS NOT NULL OR email IS NOT NULL

leases_end_after_start.name: leases_end_after_start
leases_end_after_start.value: end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date

leases_termination_reason_requires_termi.name: leases_termination_reason_requires_termination
leases_termination_reason_requires_termi.value: termination_reason IS NULL OR terminated_at IS NOT NULL

charges_published_has_date.name: charges_published_has_date
charges_published_has_date.value: status <> 'PUBLISHED' OR published_at IS NOT NULL

single_receivable_check.name: single_receivable_check
single_receivable_check.value: ((rent_installment_id IS NOT NULL)::int + (charge_allocation_id IS NOT NULL)::int) = 1

lease_receipt_versions_invalidated_requi.name: lease_receipt_versions_invalidated_requires_reason_and_date
lease_receipt_versions_invalidated_requi.value: status <> 'INVALIDEE' OR (invalidation_reason IS NOT NULL AND invalidated_at IS NOT NULL)

incidents_assignment_coherent.name: incidents_assignment_coherent
incidents_assignment_coherent.value: (assigned_to_user_id IS NULL) = (assigned_at IS NULL) AND (assigned_to_user_id IS NULL) = (assigned_by_user_id IS NULL)

incidents_assigned_requires_assignee.name: incidents_assigned_requires_assignee
incidents_assigned_requires_assignee.value: status <> 'ASSIGNED' OR assigned_to_user_id IS NOT NULL

incidents_closed_requires_closed_at.name: incidents_closed_requires_closed_at
incidents_closed_requires_closed_at.value: status <> 'CLOSED' OR closed_at IS NOT NULL

incidents_resolved_requires_resolved_at.name: incidents_resolved_requires_resolved_at
incidents_resolved_requires_resolved_at.value: status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED') OR resolved_at IS NOT NULL
